# Drama on a Sofa

> > A Korean drama (K-drama) blog featuring detailed episode recaps, previews, and commentary on popular series including Yong Pal, Descendants of the Sun, D-Day, and more.

Drama on a Sofa provides comprehensive episode-by-episode coverage of Korean television dramas, with particular focus on medical dramas, romance series, and youth dramas. The blog includes character analysis, plot summaries, and preview teasers to help fans follow their favorite shows.

## Key Topics

- Korean Drama (K-drama)
- Episode Recaps
- Yong Pal
- The Descendants of the Sun
- D-Day
- Medical Drama
- Romance Drama
- Sassy Go Go
- Coffee Please
- She Was Pretty
- Heart to Heart
- Episode Previews
- Character Relationships
- Seoul
- Korean Entertainment
